items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: I've seen Chinese. Chinese does it, yeah.

ctx.x: Just about everything. My father had one of those and at one time my father, he didn't do it often, then the other fellas had a way that he would take the snare drum and he would holler through it.
Oh, he did the holler? I've seen Chinese. Chinese does it, yeah. Showed his head once and Sammy Penn a little bit does it sometimes.
It gives Satan effect with the snare and the vibration that it would give.
